# Aisepadho

> AI-powered mock test and practice platform for India's top competitive exams — JEE Main, NEET UG, UPSC CSE, SSC CGL, Banking PO, CAT, GATE and CUET UG. AI-generated question banks, previous year papers, adaptive practice, real exam simulation, 1v1 quiz battles, group study, spaced revision and daily AI current affairs.

Aisepadho is a browser-based, installable (PWA) platform for students preparing for India's top competitive exams. It also runs as a white-label test platform for schools and coaching institutes — Guru Studio gives their teachers AI Teach Kits, a game-based Classroom Live Quiz and Soft Skills training (group discussion, speech, personality reports).

## Product

- [Home](https://aisepadho.com/): overview, supported exams, features and FAQ
- [For Schools & Coaching Institutes](https://aisepadho.com/schools): white-label platform, Guru Studio, pricing, free pilot program

## Supported exams

- JEE Main — Engineering
- NEET UG — Medical
- UPSC CSE — Civil Services
- SSC CGL — Staff Selection
- Banking PO — IBPS / SBI
- CAT — MBA Entrance
- GATE — Engineering PG
- CUET UG — University Entrance
